summary: Urban One, Inc. filed an 8-K covering its Q1 2026 earnings release and a business update. The filing details results for the period ended March 31, 2026, and provides forward-looking guidance for full-year 2026 Adjusted EBITDA of approximately $60 million. Additionally, the company disclosed it is exploring the sale of certain non-core real estate assets as part of its capital allocation and debt management strategy. No specific sale terms, buyer, or timeline were provided. The filing does not constitute a definitive agreement or formal divestiture process. This is a routine earnings and operational update, not a special situation.
